lane: A5 clock lane - untested fundamentals mechanisms on the multi-vintage PIT panel, now extended to the death-inclusive cohort (NOT the A4 distress axis: no hazard/failure-probability composite; NOT the A6 death-event axis: no death-event timing enters any decision)
title: Trade-credit chain position: long supplier-financed (payables-dominant) names, short customer-financed (receivables-dominant) names, sector-neutral on the death-inclusive multi-vintage PIT panel

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The firm's own trade counterparties and the slow-repricing float: suppliers extending open-account terms and customers taking extended terms transact on private information about the firm's operating condition that never appears in a price screen; the equity float re-rates only as quarterly statements confirm the chain position, one vintage at a time. On the short side, receivables-dominant firms' holders are slow to react because customer-credit deterioration is hard to verify from the outside and is revealed with a filing lag; on the long side, supplier-confidence signals are simply not observed by the market at all outside the filed payables balance.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: The ratio T = AccountsPayableCurrent / AccountsReceivableNetCurrent locates a firm on the trade-credit chain: T high = the firm is a net RECEIVER of supplier financing (counterparties with private information extend open-account terms - a confidence signal; scarce equity-financed working capital is conserved); T low = the firm is a net EXTENDER of customer credit (it bears its customers' default risk and a cash-conversion drag on its own operating cycle). The effect requires a death-inclusive cohort: dying firms lose supplier credit first (payables channels seize) while their receivables stop collecting - the terminal branch of the T distribution is exactly the branch a current-registry survivor panel censors, so the receivables-heavy short leg's downside is realized here rather than truncated. The conditioning is two filed stocks in a ratio with no asset scaling and no inventory leg - a chain-position shape, distinct from any signed working-capital intensity form.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: T(t) = latest-filed-vintage us-gaap:AccountsPayableCurrent divided by latest-filed-vintage us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNetCurrent, each read as-of decision date t under the funded unbounded clocks cited below (avail < gate(t), never latest-in-store); standardized to a cross-sectional percentile within the frozen sector tag s of the cohort row; tradable rank = HIGH T percentile = long leg (supplier-financed), LOW T percentile = short leg (customer-financed).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: The effect must fail (i) when anchor expectancy <= 0 after band costs - the trade-credit position premium is absent or already in price on this cohort; (ii) when the cash-coverage placebo control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x |alpha| - i.e., the information is generic settlement-liquidity stress (weak firms underperform), not chain position; (iii) when post-drop-one expectancy <= 0 or fewer than 2 of 3 folds are positive; (iv) when the pre-selection ancestry diagnostics or control-identifiability gates declared below measure out of bounds - the proposal dies before selection and is never scored.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector trade-credit-asymmetry percentile ranks predict next-quarter relative returns monotonically (high-T leg outperforms low-T leg) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) expectancy > 0 overall, (b) position PF >= 1.1, (c) risk-matched excess vs SPY positive in >= 2 folds and overall alpha > 0, (d) the same vs the mapped sector-ETF factor with ETF positive share <= 0.35, (e) the cash-coverage placebo control alpha |ratio| < 0.5 of anchor alpha, (f) neighbour (payables share of current liabilities) same-sign support, and (g) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden ancestor rank declared in novelty_declaration, measured before any selection - in particular vs the V8 WC accrual-FLOW rank and the WC stock-LEVEL shadow rank, both computed from the PIT panel before selection. If any of (a)-(g) fails, the arm is rejected and the trade-credit channel is declared untradable on this death-inclusive cohort at these costs.
literature: Petersen, M.A., Rajan, R.G. (1997), 'Trade Credit: Theories and Trade Practices', Review of Financial Studies 10(3), 661-691 (trade-credit extension as an information- and enforcement-driven bilateral choice).

Molina, C.A., Preve, L.A. (2009), 'Trade Receivables, Trade Credit, and Optimal Hedging: An Empirical Analysis of Financially Constrained Firms', Journal of Financial Research 32(4), 405-427 (receivables position interacting with financial constraint; underperformance of receivables-heavy constrained firms).

Ng, C.K., Smith, J.K., Smith, R.L. (1999), 'Evidence on the Determinants of Credit Terms Used in Interfirm Trade', Journal of Finance 54(3), 1109-1129 (credit terms encode supplier-side risk assessment).

Ferrando, A., Mulier, K. (2013), 'The Trade Credit Channel: Evidence from the Great Recession' (ECB working paper lineage; trade-credit positions reallocate as funding stress propagates - the seize-first mechanism for dying firms).

Hertzel, M.G., Li, Z., Officer, M.S., Rodgers, K.J. (2008), 'Inter-firm Linkages and the Wealth Effects of Financial Distress Along the Supply Chain', Journal of Financial Economics 87(2), 374-387 (supplier/customer linkages carry distress information before equity prices fully impound it).

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.gate_semantics: a decision at session t observes a row only if avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session (research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc, untouched canonical bridge); the selected vintage per field is the one with max avail among rows with avail < gate(t) under the cited clock; NEVER the latest vintage in the store (multi-vintage as-of semantics, V6 canonical).

pit_observable_with_availability_semanti.vintage_mixing_declaration: numerator and denominator as-of vintages may come from different filings (no shared-effective-date requirement, V8 F1 precedent); the per-decision vintage-age distribution of both legs is reported with the run; the cash-coverage placebo shares the identical mixing structure, so any staleness artifact applies to both arms and cancels in the falsification comparison rather than being argued away.

aggregation_declaration.sector_aggregates_built: NONE. Conditioning is a per-entity PIT ratio standardized to a percentile within the frozen sector tag s of the cohort row (s constant per entity).
aggregation_declaration.max_filing_gap_days: NOT REQUIRED - no aggregate over filers is computed; per-entity staleness is bounded by the cited funded clocks themselves and reported per decision.
aggregation_declaration.field_list: us-gaap:AccountsPayableCurrent, us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNetCurrent, us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue (control only), us-gaap:LiabilitiesCurrent (neighbour only) - exactly the four cited fields; no inventory field appears anywhere in this family.
aggregation_declaration.sector_factor: equal-weight mapped sector-ETF total return (SPDR map of s: XLK/XLE/XLV/XLF/XLY/XLP/XLI/XLU/XLB/XLRE) on the authorized EODHD benchmark path re-staged in P0d; a sector tag with no ETF mapping falls back to SPY and the fallback count is reported.

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.cohort_legs: bookable pool = ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) legs of research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/cohort_v9.json (price-death reconciliation 1550/1550 confirmed, 219 NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL excluded with recorded reasons, 513 GAP_COVERAGE recorded-not-servable, 19 NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE excluded by the alive-name guard); GAP_COVERAGE and excluded names are never bookable in any arm.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe_eligibility_per_decision: member of the bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited 63-bar floor, P3 dead_name_book_semantics verbatim: 'a name is eligible at a decision only with >=63 bars through it (inherited floor) and a non-UNTRADABLE band') AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; band D = UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION, excluded, L-I3 fail-closed band resolution) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD at the decision AND both cited clock fields populated as-of the decision (avail < gate(t)).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.sector_conditioning_choice: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map, 157 SIC4 entries, sic_sector_ambiguous empty); every bookable leg carries its sector tag from the cohort build; a sector with < 6 eligible ranked names abstains that decision (inherited); a name with no map entry (none expected) abstains and is reported. Trade-credit norms are strongly sector-specific (retail vs industrial chains), which is why conditioning is within-sector rather than pooled.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup_rationale: level-ratio anchor with no delta legs - no YoY seeding is needed (V8 F2 precedent: ratio-level arms used warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds ADV63 for band assignment.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.decision_grid: trading sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0,1,2,...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring (inherited default 21-session grid); approximately 22/26/27 scored decisions in S0_FOLD_1/2/3 (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile, effective holding 1-2 quarters; book forced flat at every fold boundary.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.entry_exit_fills_dead_name_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under avail < gate(t); fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill); fill_check verbatim from P3: 'a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing)'; exit_at_last_close verbatim from P3: 'a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation)'; forbidden verbatim from P3: 'no survivorship re-substitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series'.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.portfolio_construction: sector-neutral long-short: within each sector tag having >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the top-T tercile and short the bottom-T tercile, equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; at least 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.arms_note: exactly three arms, per binding rule; the control-identifiability pre-check and the ancestry diagnostics below are declared and measurable BEFORE selection and block the proposal without any PnL.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: trade-credit asymmetry percentile rank T = AccountsPayableCurrent / AccountsReceivableNetCurrent under the two cited unbounded funded clocks; long-high/short-low within sector.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: payables share of current liabilities: AccountsPayableCurrent / LiabilitiesCurrent under the cited unbounded funded clocks, long-high (obligations dominated by open-account supplier credit)/short-low, same book machinery. Required to SUPPORT the family with the same-sign alpha: both arms measure reliance on supplier financing - the anchor against the receivables book (chain position), the neighbour against the total current obligation stack (funding mix). If the neighbour carries the opposite sign, the chain-position and funding-mix readings disagree and the trade-credit story is not supported.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_placebo_control: cash-coverage placebo: CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue / AccountsPayableCurrent under the cited unbounded funded clocks, direction long-LOW/short-HIGH (i.e., 'weak-liquidity names underperform' - the liquidity-stress alternative hypothesis, declared ex ante). It shares the AP leg with the anchor (in the opposite ratio role) but replaces the receivables leg and the chain semantics with pure settlement-liquidity content: if the weak-liquidity short reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x |alpha| (control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt gate), the spread is generic liquidity stress, not chain position, and the family is falsified per the P3 causal_control_rule.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs cash-coverage: AP appears in numerator (anchor) and denominator (placebo), and Cash replaces AR - economically disjoint drivers (supplier-terms confidence vs balance-sheet cash), so ranks are expected LOW-to-moderately correlated (declared ex-ante expectation rho 0.0-0.4, gate 0.70 below); the placebo's discriminating power comes from removing the receivables side entirely, which is where the customer-credit and cash-conversion content lives. Declared ex ante, never argued post hoc.

pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability must be measurable BEFORE selection - a control rank-identical or degenerate vs its anchor cannot identify anything and must block the proposal pre-selection, from data alone, with no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.rule: On every frozen decision date t of the declared grid (63+21k per fold over S0_FOLD_1/2/3), over the pre-check universe = bookable pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha256-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns - the check is computable from the PIT panel and price availability alone, never from PnL): (R1) RANK GATE - Spearman rho with midrank tie resolution between the anchor rank vector and the cash-coverage control rank vector must be <= 0.70 on >= 90% of measured dates AND pooled |mean rho| <= 0.70; (R2) NON-DEGENERACY GATE - the largest single midrank tie-group in the control rank vector must be <= 25% of the measured universe on >= 90% of measured dates (V8 a5_h1 precedent); names with AP <= 0 are excluded from the CONTROL rank that decision (declared construction, count reported) and do not count as a tie-group; (R3) COVERAGE GATE - the control rank is populated on >= 60% of the anchor's measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR NON-DEGENERACY - the anchor rank vector satisfies R2 as well (AR > 0 required for the anchor rank; AR <= 0 names abstain the anchor rank that decision, count reported). Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (recorded INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL, fail-closed, V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.inputs: PIT panel (field vintages under the cited clocks, avail < gate(t)) + staged price bar availability (bar counts through t) ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns, no PnL - nothing scored exists at measurement time.

pre_selection_ancestry_diagnostics.purpose: plan section 1: a funded balance-sheet field does NOT license re-running a rejected mechanism form; decorrelation vs the V8 WC ancestors is measured, not argued.
pre_selection_ancestry_diagnostics.rule: computed from the PIT panel alone (no PnL) before selection, on the same frozen decision dates and pre-check universe: (A1) pooled |rho| <= 0.20 between the anchor T rank and the WC stock-LEVEL shadow rank (AR + INV - AP)/Assets, all legs under their funded unbounded clocks (Assets under its funded unbounded clock, cited from the same 56-set, used ONLY inside this diagnostic, never in any arm); (A2) pooled |rho| <= 0.20 between the anchor T rank and the V8 F1 WC accrual-FLOW rank ([dAR + dINV - dAP]/Assets_lag, YoY vintage pairs, 330-400-day eff match per the V8 F1 frozen construction). A1 exists because T and the stock shadow share the AP and AR legs; the declared reason they can still decorrelate is the functional form: the signed asset-scaled sum is dominated by the inventory and size axes that T deliberately omits, and the ratio-of-legs reorders names the signed sum does not. If either diagnostic measures > 0.20 pooled, this proposal is INELIGIBLE at D2 (ancestry too close) - no rescue variant is attempted.
pre_selection_ancestry_diagnostics.inputs: PIT panel only; the diagnostic's Assets/INV vintage reads create no arm and cite no additional arm clock.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per P3 factor_and_benchmark), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall alpha > 0; raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor; the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.35; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

base_and_stress_costs.model: inherited liquidity-band cost model per p3_invariants_freeze.json (V8 payload carried unchanged): per-fill cost by the executed name's ADV63 band as-of its own decision date, charged exactly once per fill on traded notional, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar; band A (ADV63 >= 50M) base 10 bps/side, stress 20; band B (10-50M) base 15, stress 30; band C (2-10M) base 25, stress 50; band D excluded at decision; a band-A fill has exactly V4/V5 arithmetic; L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError (no silent fallback).
base_and_stress_costs.expected_blend: the dead leg skews to lower dollar volume, so the blended base cost is expected to sit between the V8 blend (10-15 bps) and the band-C ceiling (25 bps); the arm reports fills, cost, and booked PnL split by band for base AND stress reruns; stress = the frozen 2x-band schedule (20/30/50 bps).
base_and_stress_costs.death_leg_note: exit-at-last-close carries the delisting-return leg through the price series itself; no synthetic penalty is added and none is needed for the cost model - costs remain linear in fills.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 75); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are eligible exclusions; that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-signal-leg: recompute the anchor rank on the payables side alone by replacing the denominator with LiabilitiesCurrent (AP/LiabilitiesCurrent rank - the neighbour's ratio used as an alternative anchor form); survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium exists only in the AP/AR form and dies in AP/LiabilitiesCurrent, the customer-credit side of the chain claim is unsupported and the mechanism reading narrows to funding mix (declared now, adjudicated only by the frozen rule).

margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; these are anticipations, not thresholds - the binding thresholds are the inherited gate table and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.expectancy_gt_0.0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE. The mapped AP pool (1196) intersects the mapped AR pool (1016), so the measured universe is the smaller of the two on the dead leg; a thinner measured universe concentrates leg weights and raises per-name impact, and the premium must clear 10-25 bps/side on a quarterly book. Declared thin positive margin if real.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; chain-position re-rating is quarterly-filing-paced, so PF is expected in the 1.05-1.25 band if real.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-2020) is the anticipated weak fold: the COVID receivables wave (customer defaults, terms pulled) hits the short leg's thesis hardest exactly when the long leg's suppliers also seize terms - a declared correlation regime, not a tuning opportunity; the >= 2-of-3 gate is expected to carry via folds 2-3.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; tail risk is sector-concentrated retail/industrial chain stress inside one fold.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.etf_positive_share_le_0.35: expected to pass by construction (per-sector net zero).
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: expected pass if and only if chain position (not generic liquidity) carries the spread; the R1 gate exists precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.neighbour_support: expected support (same sign); a sign disagreement between chain-position and funding-mix readings is declared as the support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation |rho| <= 0.20 pooled vs every forbidden ancestor rank (plan section 1, V8 D2 standard), measured before selection - never prose. Pre-selection-measurable checks are declared below and run from the PIT panel alone; price-input ancestors are measured at D2 with authorized data (V8 A7-N precedent) before any selection freeze.
novelty_declaration.A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM: CLEAN - no price input anywhere in the anchor rank (both legs are filed vintage values); the only price-derived quantities are the 63-bar floor, ADV63 band eligibility and the price floor, all sanctioned eligibility/cost inputs, not signals. D2 gate: pooled |rho| vs 12-1 momentum rank <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: CLEAN - no trend/SMA/vol-target/defensive rotation; sector-neutral long-short, no time-series price filter.
novelty_declaration.SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: CLEAN - no idiosyncratic shock/crash/overshoot variable; no OHLCV proxy fabrication (P3 no_ohlcv_proxy_rule).
novelty_declaration.SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: CLEAN - the 21-session grid is a fixed session-index schedule; no calendar-conditioned claim.
novelty_declaration.SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT: CLEAN - no fresh-vs-stale dollar-volume shock; ADV63 appears only in the frozen eligibility/band floor. D2 gate: pooled |rho| vs participation-shift anchor rank <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHAPE_and_vol_le: CLEAN - no variance/semivariance/vol-level quantity anywhere; this is not a Section 1.1 vol-level re-entry. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs both the V4 shape anchor and the vol-level control ranks.
novelty_declaration.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: CLEAN - no order-flow or microstructure reconstruction; 'trade credit' here is an accounting chain position from SEC filings, not an order-book object.
novelty_declaration.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: CLEAN - no securities-lending, borrow, or short-interest data; supplier trade credit from filed balances is a different instrument from securities lending.
novelty_declaration.SFV8-F1-WC-ACCRUAL-FLOW: MATERIALLY NEW FORM, MEASURED NOT ARGUED: the F1 forbidden form is the YoY signed FLOW (dAR + dINV - dAP)/Assets_lag; this anchor is the LEVEL ratio AP/AR - no delta, no inventory leg, no asset scaling. Shared leg fields do not license the mechanism, so the pre-selection ancestry diagnostic A2 (pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the frozen F1 flow rank, computed from the PIT panel before selection) is declared and binding; measured failure = ineligible at D2, no rescue.
novelty_declaration.SFV8-F1-WC-stock-LEVEL-shadow: MATERIALLY NEW FORM, MEASURED NOT ARGUED: the shadow form is the signed asset-scaled STOCK (AR + INV - AP)/Assets; this anchor is the within-working-capital ratio AP/AR (no inventory, no Assets denominator). Pre-selection ancestry diagnostic A1 (pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the shadow rank) is declared and binding; measured failure = ineligible at D2, no rescue.
novelty_declaration.SFV8-F2-DEP-RESERVE-COVERAGE_and_goodwil: CLEAN BY FIELD DISJOINTNESS - no AccumulatedDepreciation/PP&E/Goodwill field in any arm; pre-selection diagnostic declared: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the dep-coverage rank and vs the Goodwill/Assets bloat rank, computed from the PIT panel before selection; measured failure = ineligible.
novelty_declaration.V8_F1_allowance_neighbour_not_reused: the V8 F1 neighbour (AllowanceForDoubtfulAccounts/AR provision-coverage rank) is deliberately NOT re-proposed in any arm of this family: re-running an arm spec of a falsified family is a rejected-mechanism-form re-run, ineligible regardless of role.
novelty_declaration.V8_a5_ineligible_proposals: CLEAN - no asset-growth mechanism, no AOCI placebo (its measured 0.80-0.94 control failure is the reason the R1 pre-check design exists), no authorized-share placebo (its 80.8% tie degeneracy is the reason the R2 gate exists).
novelty_declaration.v9_lane_separation: not a distress-lane (A4) duplicate: no hazard composite, no failure-probability score, no death-event timing (A6) - a single filed-ratio cross-sectional shape conditioning; the death-inclusive cohort is the universe this cycle provides to every lane, not this proposal's mechanism.

implementation_estimate.build: one streaming pass over .staging_sec_v9/multivintage_panel.jsonl filtered to the 4 declared fields plus the A1/A2 diagnostic fields (low hundreds of thousands of rows from 10,073,069) into per-entity as-of stacks; reuse of research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc unchanged; arm module following research/assets/stocks/v8_family_runner.py structure (ratio_level kind) with the V9 cohort/band/dead-name semantics of p3_invariants_freeze.json; approx. 250-350 LOC new, no change to the canonical bridge or invariants.
implementation_estimate.runtime: single serial cell, well under the 120-minute hard timeout with the < 45-minute safe-stop rule; memory < 8 GB (heavy_cap 1 respected).
implementation_estimate.scoring_cells: 3 (anchor + neighbour + control; base and stress are reruns of booked cells, drop-one reruns as declared) - both A5 proposals together would consume exactly the 6-cell V9 budget; unused slots never reassigned.
